title: thelypteris cyclolepis
intro: Thelypteris cyclolepis, commonly known as the Cyclolepis fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, thereby promoting wound healing and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris cyclolepis include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
